voices.name: Juan
voices.accentEvidence: Adult male voice (30–40), Mexican Spanish, neutral Mexico City accent. Warm, clear baritone timbre with chest resonance and low sibilance. Crisp diction, an audible smile, and natural pauses; a medium-slow pace with falling intonation patterns that convey confidence. Conversational and instructional style without exaggeration; capable of shifting to a motivational or empathetic tone. Avoids strong regionalisms and over-dramatization. Ideal for financial explanations, storytelling, and tutorials.

voices.name: Pamela
voices.accentEvidence: Female voice from Mexico City, mid-30s. Warm and confident tone, conversational yet professional. Mexican accent is present but subtle, with natural pacing and clear diction. Ideal for corporate narrations and brand videos.

voices.name: Albeiro O
voices.accentEvidence: Colombian man, Bogotá accent, young, calm and measured tone.

voices.name: Carito
voices.accentEvidence: Young female voice from Bogotá. Cute, conversational delivery with natural warmth—ideal for intimate narration, casual dialogue, and relatable storytelling.

voices.name: Santiago
voices.accentEvidence: Confident and natural Argentine Spanish with a clear Buenos Aires accent. Ideal for narration, voiceovers, educational content, and Latin American media.

voices.name: Agustina
voices.accentEvidence: A clear, middle-aged Argentine female voice with a polished Buenos Aires accent and a calm, confident cadence. Her attentive, reassuring tone builds instant trust, perfect for customer service agents, guided interactions, and professional conversations.

images.concept: One whole oval golden-brown potato, slightly irregular, with a few small clearly visible potato eyes. No sprout, leaves, plate, other vegetables or cut pieces.

Reshape the round red fruit into a recognizably ripe tomato: a broad squat gently flattened body, wide rounded shoulders, two or three subtle lobes, and a shallow stem depression with short delicate contour creases near the crown. Use a small green star-shaped calyx and a short stem. No perfectly round ball, heart/apple silhouette, giant strawberry-like leaves or pointed bottom. Preserve the red colour, bold purple outline, smooth shading and transparent background.
One whole long tapered orange carrot with a small cluster of green leafy tops and a few simple root texture lines. No hand, knife, plate or additional food.
One fresh green head of lettuce with several broad overlapping softly ruffled leaves. The lettuce is the sole dominant object. No bowl, salad ingredients, cabbage-like white core or other vegetables.

A small purple-and-gold bowl filled with a modest fluffy mound of cooked white rice. Many small, short plump opaque white rice grains form a soft, slightly clumped cooked serving, with a few individual grain shapes clear around the surface. No uncooked grains, grain sack, garnish, other food, cutlery or chopsticks.

A small slightly offset stack of three very thin round soft maize tortillas, pale warm cream-gold with a few brown toasted spots and clearly visible thin pliable edges. No filling, folded taco, butter, syrup, plate or thick pancake texture.

Keep the existing purple-and-gold bowl, but replace every oversized mottled bean with many smaller smoothly skinned cooked brown beans. Aim for roughly forty to sixty little plump oval/kidney-shaped beans, with about eight to ten fitting across the bowl opening. Use subtle natural crease marks and tiny soft highlights; no orange patches, speckles, pitted texture or pebble/potato appearance. A little cooking broth may appear between beans but must not dominate.

A shallow simple purple-and-gold bowl containing a compact serving of golden cooked penne pasta. Several large short tubular noodles with unmistakable hollow diagonally cut ends. No fork, sauce, vegetables, cheese or other food.

One small plain yogurt pot with its foil lid peeled halfway back, revealing thick opaque creamy white yogurt with a small soft swirl. A simple purple-and-cream pot, no branding or writing. No spoon, fruit, milk carton or liquid pouring.

One compact triangular sandwich shown at a three-quarter angle: two triangular bread slices with a thin cheese filling and a little lettuce visibly layered between them. Show the entire sandwich as one assembled food. No separated ingredients, garnish, plate, knife or drink.

One large triangular pizza slice with a golden raised crust, melted yellow cheese, small red pepperoni circles and a little red tomato sauce visible near the edge. A compact intact slice, no cheese pull, detached ingredients, plate or hands.

One simple purple-and-cream teacup containing clear amber tea, with a small partly submerged tea bag and a fine string resting over the rim to a plain blank paper tag hanging beside the cup. A couple of subtle steam curls. The tea bag and tag distinguish it from coffee. No saucer, spoon, other food, letters or symbols on the tag.
